Interested in an RP server, where you play as a fantasy race struggling to survive in a new found Age of Strife, where Gods duke it out for control over the world of Gaea! Fledglings who are trying to gain a foothold to advance their species towards an age of imperialism. * **[Flora](https://voat.co/v/SavageGods/comments/749976)**- Created by Yuna, they are a species of flower-like people who are advanced in their technology, yet peaceful in nature. That is, unless one were to consume a Guardian Fruit from beneath the Tree of Life, turning the peaceful creature into a titan who kills many before succumbing to the fruit's effects.

* **[Candid](https://voat.co/v/SavageGods/comments/753899)**- Created by Flox for Godric, they are an anthropomorphic, wolf like creature that are guardians of the night. In this age, they have an avatar of Godric within their midst, and are a tribal theocracy.

The species is sepereated in to packs, with elders in the form of floating, fleshy spheres guiding them. They are waiting to be turned away from the draw of the coin, and prosper on their own orders.

* **[Säen](http://savage-gods.wikia.com/wiki/S%C3%A4en)**- Created by Pome, these plant-humanoids come in all [shapes](https://i.sli.mg/X8LJJ3.jpg) [and](https://i.sli.mg/mj2pzI.png) [sizes](https://i.sli.mg/jKnbEV.png). They are found everywhere around Gaea, and have the full support of Pome and its Hellite, even though they are of a pacifist nature. There reason for existing is to honor their creator though the cultivation of edible food and medicine. But who's to say such strict worship of Pome is fruitful?

* **[Fulcrid Spider Queen](https://www.voat.co/v/SavageGods/comments/750894/3687704)**-A Hellite, blessed by Tuum to bear its servants, the [Fulcrid Spiders](https://www.voat.co/v/SavageGods/comments/754437),who do her every bidding. She is being kept alive by the Fulcrum, the throne on which she resides. The Fulcrid Spiders are slowly digging their way to the surface, and are expected to be done excavating soon. With the control of a player, the Arachnaed Dynasty may finally see the light of day and rule all.

* **[Naga](https://voat.co/v/SavageGods/comments/750880)**- A [gorgon](http://maxcdn.thedesigninspiration.com/wp-content/uploads/2009/12/Naga-l.jpg) [like](https://i.sli.mg/Rnhyja.jpg) species created by Tempest, they are an intelligent, yet tragically souless species. They have an underwater kingdom, ruled by a king, whose power is denoted by a legendary crystal of reflection (gifted by {...}, recently stolen due to current conflicts). Their interaction with the rest of Gaea has been limited, meaning they have a lot of untapped potential.

* **[Lot'dy](https://voat.co/v/SavageGods/comments/753678)**- A [lizard like](https://i.sli.mg/1r0OTJ.jpg) species that was also created by Tempest, they are working class slaves to the Naga. If you claimed the Naga, you'd also claim the Lot'dy. But who's to say these cretures would never rebel against their Naga overlords if they had a player to lead a rebellion.

And the

* **[Med'ja Wildlings](http://savage-gods.wikia.com/wiki/Med'ja#Tribes_of_the_North)**- A small species of creatures that resembles mice, these were created by Hom, a now forgotten god. These Med'ja, however, have migrated north from their already claimed southern brothers, are more agressive, and worhip the darker gods.

Even with all these species to choose from, there are still many more from gods both present and forgotten waiting to be claimed. So come on over to /v/SavageGods to learn more, and maybe even play more (or at all).
